structuredOutputs.uncertainties: No affirmative evidence of an IPO, completed sale of Aikido itself, or shutdown was found in the reviewed public sources through the 2026-09-30 cutoff. The lifecycle classification therefore relies on contemporaneous company-site evidence (active operations under Aikido Security BV / Aikido Security inc.) plus the 2026 financing announcement, rather than on a registry filing or stock-market source. Reuters confirms the $60M round and valuation but does not name the round as Series B; that label comes from Aikido's own announcement. Aikido's June 2026 acquisition of Root indicates Aikido was an acquirer, not a target, but that transaction was not separately reviewed here to avoid unnecessary source use.
